fe7a6a0b: What is the fundamental principle of alchemy in Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood?
The more you give, the more you receive
To obtain, something of equal value must be lost
Blood is the currency of alchemy
The Law of Equivalent Exchange is the foundation of alchemy — the Philosopher's Stone lets you bypass it by using human lives as fuel.
4a826350: Which of the Elric brothers is the elder?
Edward Elric is the elder brother and the State Alchemist known as Fullmetal. He loses a leg and then an arm in the failed human transmutation, and hates being called short.
324763fc: What does Alphonse lose in the human transmutation?
Alphonse loses his entire body — Edward binds his soul to a suit of armor at the cost of his arm. Al can no longer eat, sleep or feel touch.
523a7a83: Which profession gives the Elric brothers the freedom to travel?
State Alchemists, funded by the Amestris military, get access to military libraries and the freedom to travel — in exchange for their military service.
dfabf132: What is Edward's title as a State Alchemist?
Edward Elric is the Fullmetal Alchemist — a title owed to his metal arm and leg (automail). It gives the work its name.
e8acf3ad: Who is Father, the creator of the Homunculi, in Brotherhood?
The being in the flask from Xerxes
Father was born in Xerxes more than 400 years ago, from Hohenheim's blood in a flask. His goal is to absorb “God” by sacrificing the people of Amestris.
030f80fc: Pride is Selim Bradley — seemingly the Führer's son, he is actually the oldest homunculus, controlling shadows with terrifying power.
8db5fbcb: Roy Mustang is the Flame Alchemist — he controls the oxygen in the air with his special gloves. A single spark sets off devastating flames.
bcb30c29: What is the entity met during a failed human transmutation called?
Truth guards the Gate of Truth — it takes the “toll” from alchemists who break the rules. It looks like a white silhouette mirroring the alchemist.
4e31c520: What is the main country where Brotherhood takes place?
Amestris is the main country — a militaristic nation centered on Central City. Its territorial expansion is orchestrated by Father to create a nationwide transmutation circle.
4194d0b3: What is Edward's mechanical prosthesis called?
Automail is a mechanical prosthesis connected to the nerves. Winry Rockbell makes and maintains Edward's.
dd6f2560: Which Brotherhood homunculus embodies the sin of Wrath and runs the state from the shadows?
Wrath is King Bradley, the Führer of Amestris — unlike the other homunculi, he ages normally. His Ultimate Eye lets him see his opponents' every move.
46e59f7b: Father wants to absorb God (the All) to transcend his condition — he uses millions of Amestrian lives as fuel for a gigantic transmutation circle.
4147efac: What is the Philosopher's Stone really made of?
The Philosopher's Stone is made of condensed human souls — which is why it bypasses Equivalent Exchange: it uses human lives as fuel. Creating one involves monstrous crimes.
5efaf1bd: Who is Winry Rockbell in the series?
Winry Rockbell is the Elrics' childhood friend and their mechanic. Pinako Rockbell's granddaughter, she builds and repairs Edward's automail.
b24b470f: What sets Edward apart from other alchemists?
He can transmute without a circle
His beard is made of gold
Edward can transmute without drawing a circle — having passed through the Gate of Truth, he gained an innate understanding of alchemical laws.
4ccfcc9f: What is the name of the Elric brothers' mother?
Trisha Elric is the brothers' mother — she died of an illness while Hohenheim was away. Her death drives the brothers to attempt the forbidden human transmutation.
daa7d2f3: Which eastern country has an alchemy called alkahestry?
Xing is the eastern country (inspired by China) — its alkahestry focuses on the flow of life energy and can heal living beings.
8a058b86: Who is Ling Yao in the series?
A prince of Xing seeking immortality
Ling Yao is one of Xing's many princes — he comes looking for the Philosopher's Stone to become emperor. He becomes Greed's vessel and ends up Emperor of Xing.
16e083b3: Which homunculus can take on anyone's appearance?
Envy can turn into anyone — jealous of humans and their capacity to love, it deeply hates them while envying them.
892b820b: Which traumatic event in Amestris history involves the State Alchemists?
The Ishval Extermination is the war in which the Amestris military wiped out the Ishvalan people — Mustang, Armstrong and Kimblee were used as weapons of mass destruction.
2833a8e8: What is Edward's final sacrifice to bring back Alphonse's body?
Edward gives up his own Gate of Truth, and therefore alchemy forever, to bring his brother back, body and soul.
32f0be9b: What is the capital of Amestris?
Central City is the capital of Amestris, home to Central Command — Father orchestrates his grand plan from the tunnels beneath the city.
9b72f05f: What is special about Van Hohenheim, the Elrics' father?
He is immortal and never ages
He is a living Philosopher's Stone holding thousands of souls
He is the strongest alchemist in Amestris
Van Hohenheim carries within him hundreds of thousands of souls from Xerxes. He does not age and can perform alchemy without a circle.
e6314612: Lust can extend her fingernails into sharp blades. Roy Mustang kills her after cauterizing his own wound with his flames.
200ff730: Who is Scar and why does he kill State Alchemists?
An Ishvalan survivor avenging the massacre
Scar is an Ishvalan survivor. His right arm bears his late brother's alchemical tattoos, and he uses it to kill State Alchemists, who were responsible for the massacre of his people.
5585303e: Which limbs does Edward lose trying to bring his mother back?
His left arm and right leg
His right arm and left leg
Edward loses his left leg in the transmutation, then sacrifices his right arm to bind Alphonse's soul to a suit of armor.
177ecffc: Who is the alchemy teacher who trained Ed and Al?
Izumi Curtis is the Elrics' alchemy teacher — a formidable fighter, she also attempted a human transmutation to revive her stillborn baby and lost several internal organs.
0c5f36b9: Which homunculus represents Greed in Brotherhood?
Greed is the rebel homunculus with the Ultimate Shield — he can harden the carbon at the surface of his body. He ends up sharing Ling Yao's body.
0a7314d9: Which female general commands Fort Briggs in northern Amestris?
Olivier Mira Armstrong, Alex's older sister, commands the Briggs fortress with an iron fist. For her, only the strong survive.
333b53cf: What is the name of the great city Father sacrificed 400 years ago to create the first Stone?
About 400 years ago, Father manipulated the king of Xerxes into drawing a huge transmutation circle that sacrificed the entire population. Only he and Hohenheim survived.
bd936217: What is the defensive ability of Greed, the homunculus of Greed?
Greed's Ultimate Shield lets him harden the carbon atoms at the surface of his body — nearly indestructible armor. Ed beats him by understanding its molecular structure.
969a9462: What do the Elric brothers discover by opening the Gate of Truth?
The formula for the Philosopher's Stone
All the alchemical knowledge of the universe
The Gate of Truth reveals alchemical knowledge — that is why Ed and Al can transmute without a circle after passing through it. This knowledge is both the Gate's gift and its curse.
45a13077: What is the name of the homunculus of Sloth, who digs tunnels under Amestris?
Sloth, the homunculus of Sloth, spends years digging the immense tunnel that traces the nationwide transmutation circle under Amestris.
0df6eff9: How does Riza Hawkeye help Mustang in the final battle against Father?
She covers him from a distance
She guides his flames when he cannot see
Blinded by the forced human transmutation, Mustang can no longer see. Riza tells him where the enemy is so he can aim his flames.
b22e0afd: What is the particular alchemy of Solf J. Kimblee, the Crimson Alchemist?
Kimblee transmutes whatever he touches into explosives, including his victims' bodies. His love of destruction makes him one of the series' most unsettling characters.
d2fbcb5a: What is the name of Winry's grandmother, an automail mechanic in Resembool?
Pinako Rockbell is Winry's grandmother and a renowned automail mechanic. She fitted Edward's first prostheses.
b5225819: What is the power of Scar's right arm?
It breaks down the matter it touches
Scar's right arm, tattooed by his brother, breaks down matter on contact. He uses it to kill his victims in a single gesture.
96c9a83e: How does Envy end after being defeated by Mustang?
It kills itself after Edward sees through its jealousy of humans
Reduced to its tiny true form, Envy is exposed by Edward: it envies humans. Humiliated, it weeps and then ends its own life.
a2accfc1: What is Drachma's role in the history of Amestris?
The target of an offensive meant to activate a node of the national circle
The source of the Philosopher's Stones
Drachma is the northern country whose invasion Amestris provokes at Fort Briggs to mark a blood crest of the nationwide transmutation circle — Drachman soldiers die to fuel Father's plan.
6bb29c4d: How does Ed finally beat Greed's invulnerable armor?
By understanding the molecular structure of carbon and destabilizing it
Ed realizes that Greed's shield is carbon arranged like diamond — he can turn it into graphite (soft carbon) by transmutation, instantly collapsing the seemingly indestructible defense.
a7b4507b: How is Hohenheim linked to the nationwide transmutation plan?
He holds half the souls of Xerxes and can counter Father
He is the main energy source
He has no link to the plan
Hohenheim holds half the souls of Xerxes — over the centuries, he spread some of them across Amestris. During the nationwide transmutation, these scattered souls counter Father's circle.
73518868: Who do Edward and Alphonse try to bring back through human transmutation?
The brothers try to bring back their mother, Trisha. The transmutation fails: Edward loses a leg, Alphonse his whole body, and all they get is a shapeless creature.
07c459ad: What is the outcome of the final confrontation between Edward and Father?
Defeated by Edward, Father is dragged by Truth behind his own Gate
Weakened, Father is beaten bare-handed by Edward. Truth then drags him behind his own Gate — the being who wanted to surpass God.
f92076e9: Which State Alchemist is known as the Strong Arm Alchemist?
Alex Louis Armstrong is the Strong Arm Alchemist. His techniques have been passed down in the Armstrong family for generations.
fc6425bc: What gesture do the Elric brothers use to transmute without a circle?
Ed and Al clap their hands together to start a transmutation — having passed through the Gate of Truth gives them an innate understanding of alchemy, with no need to draw a circle.
7b32310c: What heavy secret does Dr. Marcoh carry?
Having made Philosopher's Stones from Ishvalans during the massacre
During the Ishval war, Dr. Marcoh made Philosopher's Stones on the military's orders. Eaten up by guilt, he fled and lives in hiding.
d920b9f9: What is tattooed on Riza Hawkeye's back?
The symbols of the 7 deadly sins
Riza's back holds her father Berthold Hawkeye's research on flame alchemy. She later asks Mustang to burn the tattoo so that no one else can use it.
7707ad30: Who is the author of the Fullmetal Alchemist manga?
Hiromu Arakawa published Fullmetal Alchemist from 2001 to 2010 in Monthly Shōnen Gangan.
42a57598: Which studio produced the anime Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood?
Studio Bones produced both adaptations: the 2003 one and Brotherhood, in 2009.
08ca25fd: How many episodes does Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood have?
Brotherhood has 64 episodes, aired from 2009 to 2010, and follows the manga faithfully.
bc79e664: In what year did the first anime adaptation, which departs from the manga, come out?
The first series, from 2003, caught up with the manga and invented its own ending. Brotherhood, in 2009, adapted the manga all the way through.
36397494: Which subject drives Edward Elric up the wall?
Edward explodes with anger at the slightest allusion to his short height, a running gag of the series.
0bb4ba95: In which village did the Elric brothers grow up?
The Elrics grew up in Resembool, a country village, alongside Winry and her grandmother Pinako.
4b12cf4f: What is Alphonse's soul bound to after the failed transmutation?
Edward binds his brother's soul to a large suit of armor, using a blood seal drawn inside it.
172a468c: Roy Mustang wants to become Führer to change the country from the inside.
5386d27d: Which friend of Mustang, crazy about his daughter, is murdered by Envy?
Maes Hughes uncovers part of the conspiracy and is murdered by Envy, disguised as his wife.
4011baba: How many homunculi, named after the deadly sins, serve Father?
The seven homunculi are named after the deadly sins: Pride, Lust, Greed, Envy, Wrath, Sloth and Gluttony.
0d7a94db: Gluttony, the homunculus of Gluttony, can devour just about anything it comes across.
a2b4d553: What symbol do the homunculi bear on their bodies?
Each homunculus bears an ouroboros, a snake eating its own tail, somewhere on its body.
9c5148f5: What is the day Father launches his nationwide transmutation called?
On the Promised Day, a solar eclipse lets Father launch his transmutation across all of Amestris.
b7608ba8: What does King Bradley's eyepatch hide?
Bradley's eyepatch hides his Ultimate Eye, marked with the ouroboros, which lets him anticipate every move.
3d76f20f: Which alchemist fuses his own daughter with his dog to create a chimera?
Shou Tucker, a State Alchemist specialized in chimeras, fuses his daughter Nina and his dog Alexander, one of the most haunting episodes of the series.
1335002b: Which item do State Alchemists receive?
The silver watch proves State Alchemist status and amplifies alchemy. Edward engraved “Don't forget 3. Oct. 11” inside his.
5085a299: What do the Elric brothers do with their house before setting out on the road?
They transmute it into a workshop
So that they cannot turn back, Ed and Al burn their house down before leaving to search for the Philosopher's Stone.
a7db2135: Who does Edward start a family with at the end of the story?
The epilogue shows Edward and Winry married, with their children.
e20126d9: What is the name of Ling Yao's young bodyguard?
Lan Fan protects Ling with her grandfather Fu. She sacrifices her arm to help him escape. Xiao Mei is May Chang's little panda.
031e2dd8: What is the name of May Chang's little panda?
May Chang, a princess of Xing and alkahestrist, travels with Xiao Mei, a miniature panda.
